definitions.meaning: a large old-fashioned pocket watch was nicknamed after this root vegetable
a root vegetable served at the table

explanation.definitionFit: The same word names a bulky antique pocket timepiece and an edible root crop.

clue.text: Large cat making a row about midnight

indicators.note: the row word goes about, around, the midnight letter

parts.note: a tier is a row, as of seats
the middle letter of night is G

explanation.surface: A big cat causes a din around twelve at night.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a row' sounds like a noise but is a tier; 'midnight' is the middle of the word night.
explanation.definitionFit: The striped Asian big cat is the largest of the felines.

indicators.note: used unusually, the letters are put in an unusual order

explanation.definitionFit: Cookery directions telling how to prepare a dish.

indicators.note: the brown word goes in the consequence word

parts.note: import means significance or consequence
tan is a brown colour

explanation.surface: A man named Brown, as a result, turns serious.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Brown' looks like a person's name, perhaps the politician, but it is the colour tan.
explanation.definitionFit: A grave matter is serious and weighty.

definitions.meaning: to go for something is to prefer or support it
doing someone a kindness or a good turn

explanation.definitionFit: To favour is to prefer or back an option; a favour is a kind act of assistance.

parts.note: the dairy spread is a red herring: a butter here is something that butts, a ram, and heavenly puts it among the zodiac constellations

explanation.definitionFit: The zodiac sign and constellation of the Ram, an animal known for butting.

definitions.meaning: a low upholstered footstool or couch
belonging to the Turkish empire of the sultans

explanation.definitionFit: A padded footstool or divan, and the adjective for the Turkish sultans' imperial dynasty.

indicators.note: the lie word goes about, around, the transport word

parts.note: to rest is to lie down
a train is a means of transport

explanation.walkthrough: 'Lie' looks like a falsehood but means rest.
explanation.definitionFit: Restraint is self-control or holding back.

clue.text: They may hold what has to be laid on the table

definitions.text: They may hold what has to be laid on the table

parts.words: They may hold what has to be laid on the table
parts.note: laying the table suggests cutlery, but what is laid here is by hens, and these small cups hold it at breakfast

explanation.surface: Something that keeps hold of whatever must be put down on the table, like cards or a proposal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Laid on the table' sounds like setting out cutlery or tabling a motion; the thing laid is an egg, laid by a hen.
explanation.definitionFit: Small cups hold boiled eggs upright at the breakfast table, and eggs are what hens lay.

indicators.note: the examining word is placed after the attack word, so it comes second in the build

parts.note: a fit is a sudden attack, as of coughing
to test is to examine or try out

explanation.surface: Someone who has had a seizure is checked over and pronounced likely to pull through.
explanation.definitionFit: Darwin's phrase 'survival of the fittest' makes the best-adapted the ones that endure.

clue.text: American stars found in amusement park

definitions.meaning: the US name for the seven bright stars of the Plough
a roller coaster at a funfair

explanation.definitionFit: Americans call the Plough constellation pattern this, and it is also a fairground roller coaster.

clue.text: Correct restrictions for the construction of buildings

parts.note: proper means correct or right
ties are bonds or restrictions

explanation.surface: Proper limits are placed on how buildings may be put up, like planning rules.
explanation.definitionFit: Estate agents call houses and other buildings with their land real estate holdings.

definitions.meaning: the former German unit of money before the euro
to note something is to take notice of it, observe it

explanation.definitionFit: The Deutschmark was Germany's pre-euro money; to mark something is to notice or heed it.

clue.text: Cult follower of art as newly conceived

indicators.note: letters conceived anew are arranged into a fresh order

explanation.surface: Someone devoted to a cult takes up art as a brand-new idea.
explanation.definitionFit: A Rastafarian follows the Jamaican religious movement revering Haile Selassie.

parts.note: rough means unruly, disorderly
the cast is the set of actors in a play

explanation.walkthrough: 'plastered' suggests drunk, but means coated with plaster.
explanation.definitionFit: Roughcast is a coarse coating of lime and gravel rendered onto outside walls.

indicators.note: to fashion is to shape, so these letters are shaped into a new order

explanation.surface: A wedding dress style looks graceful on the bride.
explanation.definitionFit: Debonair describes a suave, stylish, confident manner.

definitions.meaning: a swimming stroke with both arms swung over together
the comma is a species of ... named for a white mark on its wing

explanation.definitionFit: A swimming style, and the family to which the comma, a winged insect, belongs.

parts.note: the purpose of punctuation, read literally as the dot that ends a sentence

explanation.definitionFit: The dot closing a sentence is literally a point used in punctuation.

definitions.meaning: a guard posted to keep watch
the cry shouted to warn someone of danger

explanation.definitionFit: A watchman on guard duty, and the shout 'Watch out!' warning of danger.

clue.text: Game pie has nothing in it

indicators.note: the nothing letter goes in it, inside the pie word

parts.note: a tart is a pie
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A game pie turns out to be empty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Game pie' looks like one thing, a pie of pheasant or venison; 'Game' is the definition alone.
explanation.definitionFit: Tarot is a card game played in Europe with a special pack, as well as used for fortune-telling.

parts.note: nice seems to mean pleasant, but it is the French city, and its coastal surroundings are the Mediterranean resort strip

explanation.definitionFit: The French Mediterranean coast around the city of Nice.

indicators.note: the greeting sits in the spectacles, between the two lenses

parts.note: wearing glasses, pictured as a pair of round lenses, two O shapes side by side
hi is a greeting

explanation.surface: Someone in glasses says hello somewhere in the US.
explanation.walkthrough: The two O's are a drawing of spectacles, with the greeting framed between them.
explanation.definitionFit: A Midwestern US state whose capital is Columbus.

clue.text: Parking, reversing badly, generating a jam

parts.note: P is the road-sign abbreviation for parking

indicators.note: doing it badly scrambles the letters of reversing

explanation.surface: A driver parks clumsily in reverse and causes a traffic jam.
explanation.walkthrough: 'badly' turns REVERSING into RESERVING. The traffic jam is really fruit jam.
explanation.definitionFit: Preserving fruit with sugar is how jam is made.

definitions.meaning: slang for a gun
a portion or fragment

explanation.definitionFit: Slang for a handgun, and also a portion of something.

clue.text: Pearl's mum seen in northern area

parts.note: an acre is a measure of area

explanation.surface: A pearl's mother turns up in an area in the north.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pearl's mum' is mother-of-pearl, the shiny shell lining.
explanation.definitionFit: Nacre is the iridescent shell lining also called mother-of-pearl.

definitions.meaning: a variant spelling of bologna sausage
nonsense, a load of tosh

explanation.definitionFit: Bologna sausage is also spelt this way, and the word is slang for nonsense.

clue.text: It may be taken by the injured

definitions.text: It may be taken by the injured

parts.words: It may be taken by the injured
parts.note: the injured suggests the hurt taking medicine, but here they are the aggrieved, who take umbrage

explanation.definitionFit: People who feel wronged are said to take umbrage or affront.

odd means strange, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the letters of it's
taken as written

explanation.surface: It is strange how the taxes work.

clue.text: It lives in Madagascar with the agreement of sailors

definitions.meaning: a lemur found only on that island
the naval reply acknowledging an order
